def build_environ(scope: Scope, body: bytes) ->dict[str, typing.Any]:
    environ = {}
    environ["wsgi.input"] = io.BytesIO(body)
    environ["wsgi.errors"] = sys.stdout
    environ["wsgi.url_scheme"] = scope["scheme"]
    environ["wsgi.multithread"] = True
    environ["wsgi.multiprocess"] = True
    environ["wsgi.run_once"] = False
    environ["wsgi.version"] = (1, 0)
    environ["REQUEST_METHOD"] = scope["method"]
    environ["SERVER_NAME"] = scope["server"][0]
    environ["SERVER_PORT"] = scope["server"][1]
    environ["PATH_INFO"] = scope["path"]
    environ["QUERY_STRING"] = scope["query_string"].decode("latin-1")
    environ["SCRIPT_NAME"] = scope["root_path"]
    environ["SERVER_PROTOCOL"] = f"HTTP/{scope['http_version']}"

    # Handle headers properly
    header_dict = {}
    for key, value in scope["headers"]:
        key_str = key.decode("latin-1").upper().replace("-", "_")
        if key_str == "CONTENT_TYPE":
            environ["CONTENT_TYPE"] = value.decode("latin-1")
        elif key_str == "CONTENT_LENGTH":
            environ["CONTENT_LENGTH"] = value.decode("latin-1")
        else:
            if key_str in header_dict:
                header_dict[key_str].append(value.decode("latin-1"))
            else:
                header_dict[key_str] = [value.decode("latin-1")]
    
    # Set headers with comma-separated values for duplicates
    for key, values in header_dict.items():
        environ[f"HTTP_{key}"] = ",".join(values)
    
    # Ensure CONTENT_TYPE and CONTENT_LENGTH exist even if not in headers
    if "CONTENT_TYPE" not in environ:
        environ["CONTENT_TYPE"] = ""
    if "CONTENT_LENGTH" not in environ:
        environ["CONTENT_LENGTH"] = ""
        
    return environ
